title: Unsupported Bug Reports
body:
What this article covers: 

  • Non-Standard Bug Reports
  • Unsupported Reports
  • Minor Reports
  • Unsupported Platforms

For more information on how to submit a bug, please check out this Help Center article.

Non-Standard Bug Reports

These are issues that are not supported by standard Bug Reporting, but may be reported elsewhere:

Payment related issues (submit to Billing Support)
Security bugs
Translation bugs that do not break functionality. These should be submitted to https://dis.gd/lang-feedback
API bugs. These should be reported on the API Docs GitHub Repository
Feature Requests should be submitted to feedback.discord.com

Unsupported Reports

This is a list of unsupported report topics, please check this list before you submit a bug.

Client modifications (BeautifulDiscord, BetterDiscord, etc.)
Using multiple instances of Discord on the same device at the same time. Example: Using Discord Stable, PTB, and Canary all at once.
Any bug that occurs only on virtual machines. If they can be reproduced on real hardware, it's valid
Alpha, Nightly, or developer environment browsers. If a developer environment browser update causes Discord to stop working, when it previously worked, this should be reported to the browser developers.

Minor Reports

Visual bugs with a low pixel offset ("Pixel-Bugs")
Bugs that involve spam-pressing buttons
Bugs that only appear for about a second
Reports that involve a high amount of steps to reproduce (Think if the Konami-Code resulted in a bug)
Behavior that only happens by waiting for several minutes/hours

Unsupported Platforms

For a list of platforms and devices that we do support, please check out this Help Center article.

These are the following platforms that are not supported by Discord.

Amazon Tablets (Kindle) 
ChromeOS
Mobile browser
